title_zh: 学生团队赢得机器人大赛
title_en: Good News (18/20): Student Team Wins a Robotics Competition
note_en: 一边…一边… describes two actions going on at the same time, with 一边 before each verb: 队员们一边上课，一边在放学后留下来组装和调试他们的机器人 "The team members kept up with their classes while staying after school to build and test their robot." English uses "while" once; Chinese repeats 一边 in both halves, and both actions must have the same subject.
